entry.title: New: dsh-unarchive
entry.summary: Restore archived sessions: a /unarchive command and an unarchive_session tool that remove sessions from the archive set so they reappear in the workspace at their original position (archiving never deletes data). Exact install spec: github:edfrey0044/dsh-unarchive. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
